excerpt.id: Kami memperkenalkan biji kopi single origin dengan profil cokelat dan buah.
excerpt.en: We introduce a single origin coffee bean with chocolate and fruity notes.

id: Dengan bangga kami memperkenalkan blend andalan terbaru kami, Egi Haluan. Perpaduan biji kopi dari dataran tinggi Jawa dan Sumatera menghasilkan profil rasa cokelat pekat yang berbalut sentuhan buah tropis.
Egi Haluan disangrai dalam porsi kecil setiap pekan agar kesegarannya selalu terjaga. Nikmati sebagai espresso, cappuccino, atau pour over dengan resep seduhan khas kami.
Blend ini tersedia mulai minggu depan di semua outlet dengan harga spesial bagi anggota setia Egi-Coffee.
en: We are proud to introduce our latest signature blend, Egi Haluan. A combination of beans from the highlands of Java and Sumatra delivers a deep chocolate profile wrapped in tropical fruit notes.
Egi Haluan is roasted in small batches every week to keep it perfectly fresh. Enjoy it as an espresso, cappuccino, or pour over with our signature brewing recipe.
This blend will be available starting next week at all outlets with a special price for loyal Egi-Coffee members.

title.en: Grand Opening of Our Second Branch

excerpt.id: Kabar gembira, Egi-Coffee resmi membuka cabang baru di pusat kota.
excerpt.en: Great news, Egi-Coffee officially opens a new branch downtown.

id: Kabar gembira! Egi-Coffee resmi membuka cabang kedua di pusat kota Yogyakarta, tepatnya di Jalan Malioboro 88. Ruang yang lebih luas dilengkapi area duduk outdoor yang menghadap langsung ke jalanan bersejarah.
Selama minggu pertama pembukaan, kami mengadakan workshop brew manual serta potongan 20% untuk semua menu. Barista spesial kami juga siap menjawab pertanyaan seputar biji kopi dan metode seduh.
Cabang pertama tetap beroperasi penuh. Kami tunggu kunjunganmu di kedua lokasi!
en: Great news! Egi-Coffee officially opens its second branch in downtown Yogyakarta, at Jalan Malioboro 88. A wider space with an outdoor seating area facing the historic street.

During the first week of opening, we are hosting manual brew workshops and offering a 20% discount on all menu items. Our signature baristas will be on hand to answer questions about beans and brewing methods.
Our first branch remains fully operational. We look forward to seeing you at both locations!

excerpt.id: Ikuti ajang teknik latte art dengan total hadiah menarik bagi barista muda.
excerpt.en: Join the latte art skills event with exciting prizes for young baristas.

id: Ikuti Latte Art Competition 2026, ajang adu skill menuangkan susu dan membentuk motif di atas cappuccino. Terbuka untuk barista muda dan penggemar kopi di seluruh Indonesia.
Pendaftaran gratis sampai 15 September melalui WhatsApp kami. Babak penyisihan digelar di cabang pusat, sementara grand final akan dinilai oleh dewan juri profesional.
Total hadiah mencapai puluhan juta rupiah plus kesempatan magang di roastery Egi-Coffee. Siapkan latihan terbaikmu!
en: Join the Latte Art Competition 2026, a skill showdown of steaming milk and creating designs on top of cappuccinos. Open to young baristas and coffee lovers across Indonesia.
Registration is free until September 15 via our WhatsApp. The preliminary rounds will be held at our main branch, while the grand final is judged by a panel of professional judges.
Total prizes reach tens of millions of rupiah plus an internship opportunity at the Egi-Coffee roastery. Get your best practice ready!
